name: Nova City Services Agent
description: Answers Nova City residency, driving and general service questions with cited sources, and submits applications after human approval.

skills.name: Answer service question
skills.description: Grounded, cited answers from the Nova City FAQ knowledge base.
examples: How do I renew my driving licence?

skills.name: Submit application (human approval)
skills.description: Prepares a submission and pauses for approval (input-required).
examples: Please renew my driving licence now, ref LAB-001
